questions.explanation: Mapping: SORE is coded as $\times \$ * \%$.
Stepwise removal of half, one, one and half, two sides.
Vertical inversion across horizontal water line.
T is seated next to the right of V.
Square division pattern.
T is husband of P; R is wife of Q.
Interleaved $+1$ and $-4$ letter shifts.
Opposite face dot pairs: $(5, 6), (2, 3), (1, 4)$.
Number 7 represents married nurses in the hospital.
Dot lies common to circle and triangle.
Straight linear slope on position-time graph between $t_1$ and $t_2$ indicates uniform constant speed.
Only circuit arrangement D provides an unbroken conducting loop from positive to negative battery terminal.
A human clinical thermometer is calibrated from $35^\circ\text{C}$ to $42^\circ\text{C}$ (covering normal physiological range $37^\circ\text{C}$).
$1.5\text{ m} = 150\text{ cm}$ is the shortest, while $179\text{ cm}$ is the longest.
Two mirrors inclined at $60^\circ$ form $\frac{360^\circ}{60^\circ} - 1 = 5$ symmetrical images.
Earth revolves in $365.25\text{ days}$. The extra $0.25\text{ day}$ accumulates every 4 years to add 1 full day (Feb 29).
The Moon's umbra shadow covers only a narrow strip on Earth where total solar eclipse occurs.
Magnets separate ferromagnetic metals (iron, nickel) from non-magnetic materials (copper, aluminum, plastics).
Shadow shape depends on angle of illumination and object orientation; it may not resemble the exact 3D outline.
A constriction/kink prevents mercury from falling back before reading; laboratory thermometers have no kink.
China rose turns dark pink in acid; turmeric turns red in base; phenolphthalein turns pink in base; methyl orange turns red in acid.
Air is transparent, chiffon cloth is translucent, wood is opaque, and an active bulb is luminous.
Heating sugar decomposes sucrose into black carbon and water vapour (chemical change). Heating copper sulphate is physical/reversible.
Acidic soils are treated with quicklime (CaO) or slaked lime $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$; basic soils are treated with decaying organic manure.
Weak bases like sodium bicarbonate $\text{NaHCO}_3$ and milk of magnesia $\text{Mg(OH)}_2$ neutralize excess hydrochloric acid in gastric juice.
Filtration traps insoluble sand Z on filter paper; evaporation of filtrate yields common salt X; condensed liquid is water Y.
Boiling into steam (vaporisation) and condensing on a cold metal plate are physical, reversible changes.
Polyphenol oxidase in exposed apple flesh reacts with atmospheric oxygen, forming brown melanin pigments (oxidation).
*Nepenthes* (pitcher plant) carries out autotrophic photosynthesis and heterotrophic insect digestion for nitrogen.
Decolourised leaf boiled in alcohol turns blue-black upon adding iodine solution, confirming the presence of starch produced by photosynthesis.
Scientific theories evolve, refine, and expand continuously as new experimental evidence and technologies emerge.
Streamlined body aids swimming; 2 dense fur coats and a thick layer of subcutaneous fat (blubber) trap body warmth.
Inhaled air: $21\% \text{ O}_2, 0.04\% \text{ CO}_2$. Exhaled air: $16.4\% \text{ O}_2, 4.4\% \text{ CO}_2$.
Xylem translocates water/minerals from roots; phloem translocates sucrose; pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood to lungs.
Rapid enlargement of thyroid cartilage of larynx (Adam's apple) during male puberty causes voice cracks and deepening.
Deepening of the voice occurs prominently in boys during puberty due to vocal cord thickening.
A Ganong's potometer measures the rate of water absorption which is nearly equal to the rate of transpiration in a leafy shoot.
A stoma is bounded by two kidney-shaped guard cells that swell with turgor to open the pore for gaseous exchange and transpiration.
Anaemia (iron deficiency/weakness), Kwashiorkor (protein deficiency/swollen abdomen), Rickets (Vit D deficiency/bent bones), Goitre (iodine deficiency).
Normal resting respiratory rate of a healthy adult human is $15-20\text{ breaths per minute}$.
Germination strictly requires water (hydrates enzymes), oxygen (cellular respiration), and suitable temperature (warmth).
Deficiency of Vitamin C causes scurvy (bleeding gums, petechiae, slow wound healing). Rich sources: amla, lemons, oranges.
Leaves reduced to spines reduce transpiration; stems are fleshy green and covered with thick waxy cuticles to store water.
Radish/carrot are tap roots; wheat/peas are seeds; tomato/mango are fruits; cauliflower/broccoli are immature inflorescences; cabbage is a leaf.
Atmospheric $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{NO}_2$ dissolve in rain forming $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ and $\text{HNO}_3$, lowering environmental water pH.
Paper wrapped tightly on a copper rod does not burn because copper rapidly conducts heat away; paper wrapped on plastic insulator burns.

Zinc displaces copper: $\text{CuSO}_4 + \text{Zn} \to \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{Cu}$. Rusting: $\text{Fe} + \text{O}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \to \text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3 \cdot x\text{H}_2\text{O}$. Endothermic $\text{C} + \text{S} \to \text{CS}_2$.
In dark, plants do not carry out photosynthesis but respire continuously, consuming $\text{O}_2$ and releasing $\text{CO}_2$ which turns limewater milky.
Pepsin operates in acidic stomach ($	ext{pH} \approx 1.5-2$); intestinal trypsin operates in alkaline medium ($	ext{pH} \approx 7.8-8.5$). Bile contains no digestive enzymes.
Observed only in boys: Adam's apple, facial hair, voice deepening. Observed only in girls: breast development, pelvic widening, menstruation. Common: height increase, acne, pubic hair.
